data: What research question from the study is the graph addressing?

The research question being addressed by the graph is about the performance comparison between different models under varying training data sizes. The graph shows the SARI scores of three models (LaserTaggerAR, LaserTaggerFF, and seq2seqBERT) across two datasets (Sentence Fusion on DfWiki and Split and Rephrase on WikiSplit). The caption indicates that the tagging approach (LaserTagger) generally outperforms the seq2seq baseline model when the number of training examples is limited. This suggests that the research question might be related to the effectiveness of different approaches (tagging vs. seq2seq) under constrained resources.
